description: The envelope every PING projection schema carries in-band. Binding invariant: UI CLAIM <= BACKEND PROOF. Harvest/convergence stage is tracked separately from maturity and never collapsed into it. Optional generated_at distinguishes projection build time from proof verification time.

evidence_ref.description: Pointer to the evidence: event ID, capture file, or report section. Required when maturity is PROVEN, BUILT_NOT_LIVE, or EXPERIMENTAL.

maturity.description: Maturity of the underlying backend claim. Uses the live PING vocabulary (P-16/P-17). Not a new vocabulary.

proof_status.description: Truth-matrix row status for the underlying claim where one exists.

source.description: The authority the projection reads, e.g. 'ping_missions via MissionRuntime'.

stage.description: Implementation stage of the surface itself, tracked separately from maturity.

verified_at.description: As-of timestamp of the last verification. Required when maturity is PROVEN, BUILT_NOT_LIVE, or EXPERIMENTAL.

generated_at.description: When the projection was built. Optional and additive. Distinct from verified_at (the as-of time of the last backend proof verification). Never a substitute for verified_at.

title: MaturityProofEnvelope
